# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any conversion issues

# Display the first few rows to confirm
print(sales_df.head())

# Check if 'status' column contains 'completed' and 'cancelled' as expected
print("Unique values in 'status' column:", sales_df['status'].unique())
